# ASPECT PRM Generation Context

This documentation bundle supports generation, repair, and reverse-engineering
of ASPECT `.prm` files.

Target version: ASPECT stable docs plus repository examples. Replace this line
with the exact ASPECT version you validate against.

Primary sources:

- ASPECT user documentation: https://aspect-documentation.readthedocs.io/en/stable/user/index.html
- ASPECT source repository: https://github.com/geodynamics/aspect

Primary goal:

- generate valid ASPECT ParameterHandler input files
- reverse-engineer source `.prm` files into reusable prompts
- repair invalid or weak `.prm` files while preserving intent

## Syntax Rules

- [Syntax Guide](./syntax-guide.md): Minimal valid ASPECT ParameterHandler syntax.
- [Structure Guide](./structure-guide.md): Typical section layout and nesting patterns.

## Tasks

- [Generate From Prompt](./tasks/generation.md): Convert a natural-language model description into a valid `.prm`.
- [Reverse Engineer PRM](./tasks/reverse.md): Turn a source `.prm` into a concise regeneration prompt.
- [Repair Invalid PRM](./tasks/repair.md): Rewrite malformed output into valid ASPECT syntax.

## Core Documentation

- [Parameter File Structure](./docs/parameter-file-structure.md): The main layout used by ASPECT parameter files.
- [Parameter Documentation Index](./docs/parameter-documentation-index.md): Important configurable areas and where to look first.
- [Feature Areas](./docs/feature-areas.md): Common physics and setup categories for retrieval and routing.
- [Common Validation Traps](./docs/common-validation-traps.md): Frequent ASPECT generation failures caused by invalid parameter names or invented schemas.
- [Annulus And Spherical Shell Notes](./docs/annulus-shell-notes.md): Source-aligned guidance for spherical shell and annulus-style examples in this bundle.

## Examples

- [Cookbook Examples Index](./examples/cookbooks-index.md): Real model examples from official ASPECT cookbooks.
- [Benchmark Examples Index](./examples/benchmarks-index.md): Benchmark-oriented examples and validation cases.
- [Test Examples Index](./examples/tests-index.md): Small targeted cases useful for syntax and section patterns.
- [Roundtrip Examples Index](./examples/roundtrip-index.md): Source `.prm` -> reverse prompt -> regenerated `.prm` workflow references.

## Constraints

- Final generated `.prm` output must use strict ASPECT ParameterHandler syntax.
- Every parameter line must begin with `set `.
- Subsections must use `subsection <name>` and end with `end`.
- Do not emit JSON, YAML, Markdown, code fences, or prose in final `.prm` output.
- Prefer patterns that match official ASPECT examples for the target version.
